Run complete. Final state verified: **build PASS**, git tree clean (only the two pre-existing stage-prompt JSONs; the repo-root PNGs are all from prior runs — I took none).

## Result: 13/13 pages tested, **zero app defects found**

Every charter route, all 15 Settings tabs, and every major flow was driven end-to-end — not just rendered. Across the whole run: **0 page errors, 0 API responses ≥400, 0 net DB writes.** Since nothing was broken, there was nothing to fix and nothing to commit.

**Write paths proven end-to-end** (all stubbed via `page.route`, so zero rows written):

| Flow | Verified request |
|---|---|
| Lead stage save | `PATCH /api/crm/leads/<id> {"stage":"contacted"}` |
| Pipeline drag New→Contacted | same PATCH; counts moved 9→8 / 2→3 |
| Estimate Save Draft | `POST /api/estimates` + toast "Estimate saved" |
| Task create | `POST /api/crm/tasks {"title":…,"priority":"warm"}` |
| WO milestone toggle | `PATCH /work-orders/<id>/milestones {"completed":true}` |
| Record payment (INV-0007) | `POST /invoices/<id>/payments {"amount":4397,…}` + toast |

Filters, sorts and date ranges were verified against outgoing query params rather than row identity (`&stage=new`→9 rows, `&priority=hot`→2, `&source=storm_map`→5, `&min_score=80`→1; Reports presets each hitting revenue *and* pipeline with correct start/end).

## The finding that matters more than the zero

**Eight separate "dead controls" turned out to be my selectors, not the app.** The costliest: `CustomSelect` options are class-less portal `div`s firing on `onMouseDown` (`[role=option]` → 0 matches); `.stat-card` matches nothing on the dashboard (it's `.glass.cursor-pointer.group`); the Pipeline drop target is `min-w-[280px]` (`[class*="column"]` → 0, making the Kanban look undraggable); and inputs with no `type` attribute are invisible to `input[type="text"]`. Each is now a documented recipe in the standing gotchas.

I also had to **refine an existing rule**: the Run 77 dead-input-pipeline tell (`:hover` count 0) fired twice — once genuinely (all 15 Settings tabs frozen at an identical `len=466`, fixed by `browser_close` + re-navigate) and once as a false alarm. It now requires a confirming click before you trust it.

Two things I'd flag as judgment calls: I **skipped screenshots** in favour of structured DOM/network assertions — more precise evidence, and it avoids adding to the ~300 stray PNGs already in the repo root. And I did **not** complete the canvassing pin drop, since finishing it would incur a DB write plus a geocode, against constraints 2 and 3.

Memory is updated: the coverage record Run 96 said was missing now exists at `/c/tmp/frontend-test-results.txt` (written incrementally from turn 4 so it survives a cap), plus new entries in `overnight_resume.md`, `qa_standing_gotchas.md`, and `MEMORY.md`.

Still open and handed on (unchanged by this run, all server-side or developer calls): the `qa_options_probe` custom field is still live in the production DB and visible in Settings → Custom Fields; `.qa-r91-neverrun.mjs` remains unrun; and the `automationEngine.js:75-77` enum bug is server-only — I confirmed the Tasks UI side is clean, so it can't be reproduced from the frontend.
